ux_steps.name: Upload & Visually Lossless Compress
components: DragDropZone (accepts multi-file or .zip, client validates count <= 300)
BatchSummaryCard (image count, total MB raw vs estimated 220-PPI compressed)
CompressionProgressIndicator (Lanczos, EXIF upright, unsharp mask, 4:4:4 subsampling)

ux_steps.name: Sequential Classification Pipeline
components: LiveStreamingProgress (Server-Sent Events / WebSocket, current image index / total)
ActiveImageCard (thumbnail, detected category, extracted article/size, confidence score, tier badge: Qwen-3.8 / Fallback)
PacingController (inter-request token limiter visualization, failover indicator)

ExclusionToggle (1-click include/exclude for 11C Inspector Notes / duplicates)

AuditModal (confirms SSIM >= 0.97, 220 PPI print standard, 100% editable cell captions)
